attempts.prompt: Generate exactly one transparent raster idle sprite of the ghost Peter Walls, Victim 12/21 in the original Silent Hill 4: The Room (2004), for the lateral duel view. The full figure from the original game is the first image. The original second image shows the posture of his floating approach. The final image is the existing selection art for continuity. Show Peter alone, in a different pose, almost strict side profile facing SCREEN RIGHT, nose, chest and leading hand aiming right, hips and shoulders in profile. He is a fully clothed 13-year-old teenage boy with age-appropriate proportions. Retain the original black knit cap, short dark zip track jacket with two parallel ochre stripes down each sleeve, worn ochre cargo trousers, and dark low trainers with lighter tips. Keep his face pale and shaded by the cap with a quiet, vacant expression; no injuries or graphic details. Characteristic low hovering idle, modest forward drift in the torso, asymmetrically bent knees trailing left, neither foot planted. One loosely raised hand leads from the front at chest height, the other hangs by the near hip so both outlines read. Show the whole head, both feet within frame and clearly separated elbows and knees. Follow the dark warm brown, charcoal and ochre palette rather than desaturating the jacket stripes. Detailed original-game naturalistic textures, softly directional diffuse lighting, fine contour visible at fighter size. True RGBA transparency and generous empty margins. No other character, scene, motion streak, shadow on a floor, ghost cloud, text, UI, weapons or impact effects. Single independent game asset.
